# Collins Dictionary

> > Comprehensive English language dictionary providing authoritative definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, and translations from Collins, with integrated support for word games like Scrabble and Wordle.

Collins Dictionary is a trusted language reference resource offering detailed word definitions, usage examples, pronunciation guides, and thesaurus entries. The platform serves language learners, writers, and word game enthusiasts with comprehensive English language tools and multilingual translation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- English Dictionary
- Word Definitions
- Pronunciations
- Synonyms and Antonyms
- Language Reference
- Translations
- Scrabble Word Finder
- Wordle Helper
- Grammar Guides
- Usage Examples
- Etymology
- British and American English
- Thesaurus
- Language Learning

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Collins English Dictionary | Definitions, Examples, Pronunciations & Synonyms](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english): Main English dictionary with definitions, pronunciations, and synonyms
